items.descriptionEn: A named output and its ordered processing chain.
A processor in the named output.

config.descriptionEn: Processor type-specific configuration. Standard fields are validated by the service, while parameters are preserved and returned as an open field.

applications.descriptionEn: Applications to which a data-security processor applies. An asterisk (*) means all applications.

items.descriptionEn: An application name, or an asterisk (*) for all applications.

assignments.descriptionEn: Field expression assignments applied in order by an extend processor.

items.descriptionEn: A field expression assignment used by an extend processor.

expression.descriptionEn: The SPL expression used to compute the output field value.

field.descriptionEn: The field to which the expression result is written.

expression.descriptionEn: The SPL condition expression used by a filter processor.

fields.descriptionEn: Telemetry field paths processed by a field processor.

items.descriptionEn: A telemetry field path.

parameters.descriptionEn: Optional open extension parameters. The service preserves and returns them unchanged. The span2metrics processor validates and consumes window, filter, dimensions and metrics; other processors retain their existing behavior.

projections.descriptionEn: Field selection and rename rules applied in order by a project processor.

items.descriptionEn: A field selection and rename rule used by a project processor.

target.descriptionEn: An optional output field name. The source name is retained when omitted.

rules.descriptionEn: Masking rules used in order by a mask_fields processor.

items.descriptionEn: A field masking rule.

keepPrefix.descriptionEn: The number of leading characters preserved after masking.
keepPrefix.description_en: The length of the prefix to retain

keepSuffix.descriptionEn: The number of trailing characters preserved after masking.
keepSuffix.description_en: The length of the suffix to retain

keys.descriptionEn: Sensitive keywords matched in keyword mode.

items.descriptionEn: A sensitive keyword.

maskChar.descriptionEn: The single character used to replace sensitive content.

mode.descriptionEn: The masking rule mode. Valid values are buildin and keyword.

types.descriptionEn: Built-in sensitive data types detected in buildin mode.

items.descriptionEn: A built-in sensitive data type.

scope.descriptionEn: Service, metric and field clauses use AND; values use OR. Omitted or empty scope applies to all records; unmatched records continue. traces-default/events-default support filter, extend and redact_fields; apm-metrics-default also supports dimension project. Scoped Trace/Event extend requires keepOriginalFields not false. Safety processors use applications; spl/export/span2metrics do not accept scope.

conditions.descriptionEn: Optional; when present must contain 1–20 clauses. An empty array is invalid. Clauses use AND.

items.descriptionEn: A field clause combined with other clauses using AND.

field.descriptionEn: Required, source-aware scalar, Label or JSON property reference.

container.descriptionEn: Required for json: Trace attributes/resources; Event resource.entity/resource.tags/labels/annotations/data. Forbidden for field/label.

kind.descriptionEn: Required. field: declared Trace/Event scalar; label: Metrics Label; json: property in a declared Trace/Event object container.

name.descriptionEn: Required for field/label; forbidden for json. field must be a declared source scalar. label must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,255} and must not start with __.

path.descriptionEn: Required for json: 1–8 literal object keys, each nonblank, at most 256 characters and without controls. Dots are literal; array indices are unsupported. Missing, invalid JSON, null, empty or non-string leaves do not match. Forbidden for field/label.

items.descriptionEn: A literal, nonblank object key of at most 256 characters without controls; dots belong to the key.

matchType.descriptionEn: Required. EXACT is case-sensitive. GLOB supports only *; %, _ and ? are literal. ALL is unsupported.

values.descriptionEn: Required: 1–100 unique, nonblank strings of at most 256 characters each, without control characters; combined with OR.

items.descriptionEn: A nonblank string of at most 256 characters without control characters.

metricName.descriptionEn: Only supported for apm-metrics-default; preserves the existing ALL/EXACT/GLOB matching rules.

matchType.descriptionEn: The metric-name match type. Valid values are ALL, EXACT, and GLOB.

values.descriptionEn: Metric names or patterns used by EXACT or GLOB. Omit this field for ALL.
